name: Dak'Art, the Dakar Biennale of contemporary African art
subtitle: Dak'Art is a biennale in Dakar organised under the Senegalese Ministry of Culture.

facts.label: Organiser
facts.value: The organiser is listed as the Senegalese Ministry of Culture.

facts.label: Founding
facts.value: Dak'Art was conceived in 1989 as a biennale alternating between literature and art.

facts.label: First editions
facts.value: The first edition in 1990 focused on literature and the 1992 edition on visual art.

facts.label: Role
facts.value: In 1996 Dak'Art became an exhibition specifically devoted to contemporary African art.

facts.label: Local roots
facts.value: The biennale came about through the Senegalese state and local artists who since the seventies had organised regular annual art exhibitions.

facts.label: Funding risk
facts.value: In 2010 the European Commission, a major financial partner, did not support the event.

facts.label: Curators
facts.value: The 2016 edition was curated by Simon Njami.

parts.text: Dak'Art is a biennale in Dakar organised under the Senegalese Ministry of Culture. Conceived in 1989 to alternate between literature and art, it held its first visual-arts edition in 1992 and became an exhibition devoted to contemporary African art in 1996.
